question: What is the slogan for the UAE's 2025 "Year of Community" initiative announced by President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hand in Hand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan announced 2025 as the “Year of Community” under the slogan “Hand in Hand.”**
 
• The initiative aims to foster unity, inclusion, and social cohesion across the UAE.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The campaign emphasizes collective efforts to strengthen social bonds and unlock sustainable growth.**
 
• It encourages citizens and residents to engage in community service, volunteering, and cultural diversity initiatives.
 
• Vice President Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid highlighted the importance of strong families in building a thriving community.
 
• The UAE is home to over 4 million Indians, who contribute significantly to the country’s diverse population.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Year of Community Initiative__

 __
 
• Focuses on unity, inclusion, and fostering shared responsibility within the UAE.
 
• Includes events and programs promoting volunteering and community engagement.
 
 
 
• Impact of Indian Community__
 
 
• Over 4 million Indians reside in the UAE, contributing to its cultural and social diversity.
 
• India and the UAE maintain strong bilateral ties through mutual contributions.
